subject: general
question: What is the primary disadvantage of using a digital frequency counter in high-frequency measurements?

options.text: Limited resolution at very high frequencies due to counting limitations

solution:
The correct answer is option 2

__**Explanation:**__

The **primary disadvantage of a digital frequency counter at very high frequencies** is related to its **counting mechanism**.

 
• 
 
A digital frequency counter measures frequency by **counting the number of cycles within a fixed gate time**.

 
 
• 
 
At **very high frequencies**, accurate counting becomes difficult due to:

 
 
• 
 
finite gate time,

 
 
• 
 
trigger and counting limitations,

 
 
• 
 
and time-base constraints.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
This results in **reduced resolution and accuracy** at very high frequencies.
